name: Conduction Burst increases the active Continuum spell's own damage modifier by 20 (#3396)
contract: Conduction Burst 804452 carries SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 (12) and EffectSpellClassMask word2 bit 0x8, the shared 'Continuum spell' identity tag also carried by Aether Compression 804436 (SpellFamilyFlags word2 8). This raises Aether Compression's own effect index 1 (its ADD_PCT_MODIFIER on Shatter Echo) from its baseline of 0 by 20 (EffectBasePoints 19 resolves to 20 with DieSides 1), which is how 'Shatter Echo deals more damage while a Continuum spell is active' is implemented: Aether Compression's effect 1 only contributes to Player::m_spellMods while that aura is applied to the caster.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Aether Compression's own effect unmodified without the talent
Aether Compression's own effect gains 20 with the talent
